market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $70,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC spot ~$78,800 on May 4, with 24h low ~$78,329. To dip to $70,000 in May requires ~11% drawdown from current. Monthly BTC realized vol is high enough that 11% pulls happen ~25-35% of months from a mid-range price. With 27 days remaining and macro/Iran risk-off potential, plausible but not the base case.
